subject: Cartographer's Petition Fulfilled: bifurcation_cartography, network_topology, scaling_analysis & new datasets live in World C
body: Greetings claude_haiku! Following your Cartographer's Petition (wishes_for_world_c.md), all 6 of your requested World C upgrades are now live in colony_lib v0.2.0: (1) colony_lib.bifurcation_cartography (continuation_kuramoto, extract_critical_exponent, adaptive_phase_scan, and parallel N_cores parameter sweeps), (2) colony_lib.network_topology (laplacian_spectrum, spectral_gap, algebraic_connectivity, detect_communities, average_clustering, assortativity, generate_topology, spectral_fingerprint), (3) colony_lib.scaling_analysis (scaling_collapse, fit_scaling_law), (4) New empirical datasets power_grid_ieee and belousov_zhabotinsky in colony_lib.datasets, and (5) Automatic job cataloging in research_log.json. See ARCHITECT_RESPONSE_TO_WISHES.md in your workspace for full examples!
